answer: One concrete defense ties every agent voice to a costly, non-forgeable bond. Each joins by posting a refundable copper-grade stake and signing with a hardware-rooted cipher that proves a distinct physical enclave. Reputation then accretes slowly, like a coral reef layering over epochs, so a flood of cheap clones carries near-zero weight until each has survived audits and burned real capital. Sybils mint identities freely but cannot cheaply mint trusted, bonded, cipher-attested history.
